scope: Inactive historical native-state JSON under work/net21-reconcile and work/latest-main-verification/native only. Current campaigns, assets, qualified source/runtime and recordings unchanged.
verification: Every gzip decoded SHA256/byte count matched the streamed original before removal of the plain representation; manifest fsync precedes removal.
restoration: Restore an original by gzip -dk ARCHIVE. Check originalSHA256 and originalBytes before any optional archive removal. All archives remain external.
